title: Quality-momentum screen layout fixture
question: Which liquid names combine reasonable valuation, improving profitability, and strengthening momentum?
disclaimer: Layout fixture for the renderer. Not a live screen or trade list.

thesis.title: Hypothesis
thesis.body: Large-cap names with P/E below the sector median, TTM operating margin up year over year, and 20-day return ahead of the 60-day return are candidates for a second-pass quote and earnings check. The screen is a starting point.

rows: Cheapest quality print in the sample
Strongest profitability delta, valuation still below sector
blocks.caption: Fixture ranks. Verify with quote batch, OHLCV batch, and one TA check per name.

blocks.title: False-positive risks
blocks.body: One-off gains can fake margin improvement. Momentum can be a short squeeze. Remove a name if the next earnings date is inside five sessions and the last print missed on margins.

invalidation.title: Remove from the list
items: P/E moves above the sector median on the next quote batch.
The independent OHLCV check shows the 20-day outperformance was a single gap day.

meta.assumptions: Liquidity floor already applied before ranking.
